label: Every actual root has a favouring determination
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every actual concrete root r at w has, for some favouring profile phi, the real determination that a favouring of r is phi. It is the weakest form of commitment (e) of #2145 (the foundation originates objective finality) under the favouring senses ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1 and ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2: each includes an own favouring of the origin, but the finality conditions themselves are not part of this statement. It does not cover a root that originates finality only as an object of appetite, with no favouring of its own (the final-cause-as-object reading, a recorded rival).
